RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel at a public university may violate institutional diversity or recruitment policies. If explicit guidelines require gender-balanced search committees, you have clear procedural grounds to raise it. 

However, raising it solely as proof of bias before receiving written feedback is risky. While your publication and qualification record is stronger on paper, committees also evaluate interview performance, teaching demonstrations, references, and specific curriculum needs like industry experience.

First, send a polite follow-up regarding your requested feedback. If the university breached procedural rules or provides an evasive explanation, consult a staff union representative or institutional equity officer to explore formal inquiries or grievance procedures.
